title: Normal Equations and Discrete Energy Structures for High-Order Streamline Diffusion
summary: We analyse fully discrete Streamline Diffusion finite element methods, also known as SUPG methods, for time-dependent first-order systems with skew-symmetric spatial operators. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first stability and a priori error analysis of strongly consistent Streamline Diffusion finite elements combined with linear multistep schemes of order greater than two for multidimensional first-order hyperbolic systems.
